corrections.reason: The reference solution unwinds x_n = ((n - 2010)/n) x_{n-1} as (-1)^n 2009 C(2008, n); the recursion gives (-1)^n 2009 C(2009, n) (x_1 = -2009^2). The requested sum is then 2009 (1 - 2)^2009 = -2009.
